# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability or potential memory safety issue in Syllogist:

1. **Do not open a public issue.**
2. Please contact the project code owner directly:
   - GitHub: [@thrive-spectrexq](https://github.com/thrive-spectrexq)

We take memory safety and vulnerability reports seriously and will investigate, fix, and release patches promptly.
